blocks.text: Tuple bhi list ki tarah cheezon ka tarteeb wala majmua hai, magar ek bara farq hai: tuple immutable (na badalne wala) hai, yani banne ke baad us ki values badli nahi ja saktin. Tuple qausain ( ) mein likha jata hai.

# Creating a tuple
my_tuple = (1, 2, 3, "Hello", 4.5)

# Accessing elements by index
print(my_tuple[0])  # Output: 1
print(my_tuple[3])  # Output: Hello

# Tuple length
print(len(my_tuple))  # Output: 5
Wazahat: my_tuple[0] pehla item 1 deta hai, my_tuple[3] chautha item "Hello", aur len() items ki ginti 5 deta hai.

blocks.prompt: my_tuple[0] = 10 karne ki koshish par kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Python TypeError deti hai, kyunke tuple badla nahi ja sakta.

items: Tuple: ( ) mein; index se parhte hain; badal nahi sakte (immutable).
